summary: Tested Craig's 5 feedback items. 6 of 7 features working correctly. 1 bug found: clicking quote card in Company Quotes tab navigates to CPQ list instead of quote detail.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking quote card navigates to CPQ list page instead of quote detail. CRMCPQ component doesn't handle navTarget to show quote detail.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Add useEffect in CRMCPQ.js to check navTarget.type === 'quote' and set selectedQuote to navTarget.id

feature_1_company_quotes_tab.details: Quote cards display correctly with status badge, version, and data-testid. However, clicking navigates to CPQ list instead of quote detail.

feature_2_pipeline_print_report.details: Report button (data-testid='print-report-btn') is visible and enabled in Pipeline header.

feature_3_contacts_company_badge.details: Contacts show blue pill badge for assigned company (e.g., 'Fieldview Primary School') and red 'Unassigned' tag for unassigned contacts.

feature_4_deal_contact_filtering.details: New Deal dialog shows 'Select company first...' in contact dropdown. After selecting company, contacts are filtered to company contacts only.

feature_5_quote_contact_filtering.details: New Quote dialog shows 'Select company first...' in contact dropdown. After selecting company, contacts are filtered correctly.

feature_6_calendar_tab.details: Calendar nav item present in sidebar with CalendarDays icon. Calendar shows month grid with 7 columns (MON-SUN).

feature_7_calendar_features.details: Today button, prev/next month navigation, activities plotted on dates with color-coded event types (green, blue, orange, cyan). Day detail panel shows events when clicking a date.

action_items: Fix CRMCPQ.js to handle navTarget for quote navigation from Company Quotes tab. Add useEffect to check navTarget.type === 'quote' and set selectedQuote = navTarget.id
critical_code_review_comments: CRMCPQ.js missing navTarget handling - other components like CRMCompanies.js handle navTarget correctly but CRMCPQ doesn't
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 109 tested Craig's 5 feedback items. All features working except quote navigation from Company Quotes tab. The fix is straightforward - add navTarget handling to CRMCPQ.js similar to how CRMCompanies.js handles it.
